patch_description: Introduce a modest increase in expressivity by spliting the ring entanglement gate parameters into two parameter groups. The outer-ring CRY gates will be assigned to two distinct parameter keys (cry_ring_A for the first half of the ring, cry_ring_B for the second half). This preserves the overall architecture and adjacency constraints while providing per-edge flexibility in the ring entanglement. The hub (CRX) and other layers remain unchanged, keeping parameter budget largely controlled. This targeted change aims to improve validation/test performance by enabling the optimizer to explore a richer entangling pattern without a large parameter explosion.
